english.title: Use / attempt to use / possess more than one workshop card on which identified as holder or PIN - tachograph cards
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[used]_
(B)_[attempted to use]_
(C)_[were in possession of]_

more than one

(D)_[workshop card on which you were identified as the holder]_
(E)_[PIN for use in connection with a workshop card]_

in respect of the same place of work
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 4(1)(a) and (4) of the Passenger and Goods Vehicles (Recording Equipment) (Tachograph Card) Regulations 2006.

english.notes:
Regulation 4(3) of the Passenger and Goods Vehicles (Recording Equipment) (Tachograph Card) Regulations 2006 provides a defence. It is not an offence-
(a) to hold a workshop card which will become time-expired within one month and the workshop card which has been issued by the Secretary of State in renewal of the former card; or
(b) to hold a workshop card, which has become time-expired, in combination with another card.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
